title: Solute
summary: SOLU'TE, adjective [Latin solutus, solvo.] 1. In a general sense, loose; free; as a solute interpretation. [Not in use.] 2. In botany, loose; not adhering; opposed to adnate; as a solute stipule. SOLU

inlines.v: SOLU'TE, adjective [Latin solutus, solvo.] 1. In a general sense, loose; free; as a solute interpretation. [Not in use.] 2. In botany, loose; not adhering; opposed to adnate; as a solute stipule. SOLU'TE, verb transitive To dissolve. [Not in use.]
